note: R6 V0 (#1594): link address grammar, the WebSocket profile of the link and its upgrade. No keys. The hub replays every case; orch-core every case except check_request, build_response and build_refusal.

cases.name: addr_direct_name_case_kept
cases.note: host as written; SNI in lower case

cases.name: addr_wss_explicit_default_port
cases.note: the Host header leaves out the default port

cases.name: addr_ws_ipv4_port
cases.note: an IP literal gets no SNI

cases.name: addr_wss_punycode
cases.note: an internationalised name only in its xn-- form

cases.name: addr_path_slash
cases.note: the path is fixed (/orch/link/1); none in the address

cases.name: addr_userinfo_user
cases.note: user info is refused, never stripped

cases.name: addr_ipv4_three_parts
cases.note: a numeric last label must be a whole dotted-quad address

cases.name: addr_ipv4_hex_last_label
cases.note: a last label that starts with a digit is a whole IPv4 address

cases.name: connect_proxy_url
cases.note: a connect link never carries a proxy

cases.name: where_proxy_as_link
cases.note: the hub never sends proxy settings

cases.name: enc_binary_masked_rfc
cases.note: RFC 6455 §5.7 masked 'Hello' with the binary opcode

cases.name: dec_server_masked_refused
cases.note: a server frame is never masked

cases.name: dec_client_unmasked_refused
cases.note: a client frame is always masked

cases.name: dec_compressed_rfc7692
cases.note: RFC 7692 §7.2.3.1 compressed 'Hello': RSV1 (no extension is ever negotiated)

cases.name: dec_ping_126_from_header
cases.note: decided from the first two bytes

cases.name: dec_len16_short_form
cases.note: a length that fits 7 bits in the 16-bit form

cases.name: dec_len64_short_form
cases.note: a length that fits 16 bits in the 64-bit form; decided before any payload

cases.name: dec_oversize_from_header
cases.note: 256 KiB + 1: refused from the header alone, no payload sent

cases.name: dec_only_first_frame
cases.note: the rest stays in the buffer

cases.name: stream_ping_answered
cases.note: a ping alone yields no link bytes (wait_readable stays False)

cases.name: stream_close_ends
cases.note: bytes after the close are ignored; the answer is a close 1000
